title: All Dreams Must End - How to Earn & Missable Status
description: All Dreams Must End trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and how the PS5 and Steam lists differ.
keyword: All Dreams Must End phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The ordinary ending rather than the true one, which means it is easy to reach by accident on a first run and impossible to skip if you are chasing the platinum anyway.

sections.title: How to Earn
sections.content: Reach the ending where all schemes come to nothing - the Meng Hua route.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: Trophy 4 of 36 on the list - before it With Heart and Blood · after it The Four Freed. It is not missable, so a missed run can be finished later without a restart. The full list with rarity is on the trophy list; the Platinum route and the order to do things in are on the trophy guide.
